summary: CSB Financial Inc. filed an 8-K announcing completion of its initial public offering in connection with the mutual-to-stock conversion of Community Savings Bank. The company sold 1,375,435 shares at $10.00 per share, including 112,235 shares to an ESOP, raising approximately $13.8 million gross, plus 27,500 shares to a foundation. Shares begin trading on OTCQB under CSBA on July 30, 2026. This is a routine IPO completion, not a special-situation event, so no category applies.
